newsitem.title: USA: US late spot heat gains, gasoline mixed with NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: US late spot heat gains, gasoline mixed with NYMEX.

text.p: U.S. cash distillates continued to gain ground with NYMEX by late Friday with gasoline showing mixed results after being pummelled all week long, traders said.
Heating oil jumped about 0.65 cent in both centers tracking October futures, players said, while differentials held steady.

But a plethora of sellers weakened diffs on jet fuel in both the Gulf Coast and New York Harbor, with Gulf low-sulfur 55 grade easing 0.60 cent to an offering price of 2.30 cents above the print, players said.
"There were a few inquiries in the past few days for 55-grade to go to Europe, but that talk seemed to have died off today," one Gulf player said.
Sellers in a thin gasoline market helped soften diffs on New York Harbor reformulated A4 grade by 0.30 cent to about 0.40 cent below the print, players said.
"We see a whole lot of gas heading our way from Europe," one East Coast player said, in anticipation of autumn refinery turnarounds.
